name: dev.codevisor/slack
title: Slack
description: Search, read and post in Slack as you, and wake bots on mentions, DMs and replies.

guide.title: Connect Slack
guide.summary: Connect Slack through a small app in your workspace. It takes about two minutes.

steps.title: Create the Slack app
steps.detail: Create a Slack app to give your agents access to Slack.

display_information.name: Codevisor
display_information.description: Lets your Codevisor agents read Slack and post as you, with your approval.

steps.title: Signing Secret
steps.detail: Copy the Signing Secret from Basic Information › App Credentials.

steps.title: User OAuth Token
steps.detail: Copy the User OAuth Token from OAuth & Permissions › OAuth Tokens.

tools.name: search_messages
tools.description: Search messages the user can see. Supports Slack search syntax such as in:#eng from:@ana after:2026-11-01 has:link. Returns matches with permalinks, newest first unless sort is relevance.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Search files shared in conversations the user can see. Supports Slack search syntax.

tools.name: list_channels
tools.description: List conversations the user is in: channels, private channels, DMs and group DMs, with ids. Filter by name with query.

tools.name: find_users
tools.description: Find people in the workspace by name, @handle or email. Returns user ids for mentions and DMs.

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Get a person's profile: name, handle, title, email and time zone. Pass me for the user.

tools.name: read_channel
tools.description: Read a conversation's recent messages, oldest first, with each thread's reply count. Use nextCursor for older messages and read_thread for replies.

tools.name: read_thread
tools.description: Read a thread: the parent message and its replies, oldest first.

tools.name: list_channel_members
tools.description: List the people in a conversation, with names.

tools.name: download_file
tools.description: Download a file shared in Slack to this machine. Returns its local path, and its text when it's a small text file.

tools.name: add_reaction
tools.description: React to a message with an emoji.

tools.name: remove_reaction
tools.description: Remove the user's emoji reaction from a message.

tools.name: post_message
tools.description: Post a message as the user, or reply in a thread with threadTs. Requires the user's explicit approval: confirm must be true.

tools.name: schedule_message
tools.description: Schedule a message to post later as the user. Requires the user's explicit approval: confirm must be true.

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Share a file from this machine in a conversation as the user. Requires the user's explicit approval: confirm must be true.

events.name: message.posted
events.description: Someone else posted in a conversation you're in. Filter it: busy workspaces post a lot. For example channel.name == "incidents" or text.contains("deploy").

events.name: mention.created
events.description: Someone else @-mentioned you in a message.

events.name: dm.received
events.description: Someone sent you a DM or wrote in a group DM you're in. channel.type is dm or group_dm.

events.name: thread.replied
events.description: Someone else replied in a thread you started.

events.name: reaction.added
events.description: Someone reacted to one of your messages. reaction is the emoji name, such as white_check_mark.

skills.name: slack
skills.description: Work in the user's Slack safely: search and read conversations, post only with explicit approval, and react to Slack events with filters.
